mentions.name: AI-native Todoist CLI
mentions.description: This is an AI-native command-line interface for Todoist that treats both humans and AI agents as first-class users. It supports automating action item extraction from Obsidian notes and provides TTY-aware output, a schema command for agent discovery, and idempotent operations.
mentions.problem: The author needed to solve the personal problem of automating action item extraction from his Obsidian notes into Todoist.
mentions.audience: AI agents and the author for personal task management; also useful to humans using Todoist
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building an AI-native CLI for Todoist [1]. Started to solve a personal problem, automating action item extraction from my Obsidian notes, but it's become something bigger. The CLI treats both humans and AI agents as first-class users: TTY-aware output, a schema command for agent discovery, idempotent operations, that kind of thing.
